Pole-sitter wins (9):
1. Australia: Giancarlo Fisichella (started 1, won)
2. Malaysia: Fernando Alonso (started 1, won)
3. Bahrain: Fernando Alonso (started 1, won)
4. Spain: Kimi Räikkönen (started 1, won)
5. Monaco: Kimi Räikkönen (started 1, won)
6. France: Fernando Alonso (started 1, won)
7. Turkey: Kimi Räikkönen (started 1, won)
8. Italy: Juan Pablo Montoya (started 1, won)
9. China: Fernando Alonso (started 1, won)

Races where the winner did not start from pole (10): San Marino, Europe, Canada, USA, Britain, Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Brazil, Japan.

The season-standings wins (Alonso 7, Räikkönen 7, Montoya 3, Schumacher 1, Fisichella 1) sum to 19, which matches the race count.

The grid positions come from the top-10 finisher lists in the race reports. The winner's grid position was available for every race, so no race was left unverified.

ANSWER: 9
